summary: Short north kerb at the Shirley Street dead end, houses 13-17 m away.
reasons: Short kerb, no-stopping sign beside it

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 13 m, 17 m and 20 m away on this side; kindergarten 22 m; apartments beyond.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed turning head with a car parked there; the pavement edge limits room on this side.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end street, very little through traffic.
drivers.convention: 2P weekday 9-5 and a no-stopping sign at the kerb; cars do park nearby.

flags: No-stopping sign 1.3 m from the kerb line
sun_shade: Open to the sun from the north-east; trees shade the south and east.

best_section.where: North kerb of the Shirley Street dead-end turning head
